PHASE.NAME: RTK Language Adapter Parity
PHASE.GOAL: Port or wrap RTK language ecosystem adapters for Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, JVM, and .NET workflows.

STEPS.step-1: Added first-class language ecosystem proxy shortcuts for ruff, mypy, basedpyright, pip, uv, next, playwright, prettier, prisma, tsc, vitest, and gradlew while preserving existing pytest/npm/pnpm/go/ruby/rust/dotnet delegates.
STEPS.step-2: Expanded router behavior and examples to cover direct JavaScript/TypeScript tools without requiring npx wrappers.
STEPS.step-3: Verified existing RTK filter pack; no missing inline filter cases were required for this phase.
